rows.abstract: \"Tourism Act of 2004.\" The bill provides for the adoption of a national tourism policy to a) guide the course and pace of tourism development; b) coordinate the functions and resources of government agencies in tourism programs; and c) improve the quality of life of the people by promoting ecotourism.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06088

rows.author: D098
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE BEGINNING OF HUMAN LIFE, RECOGNIZING RIGHTS THEREUNDER, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Human Life Act.\" The bill defines the beginning of human as \"from the moment of the combination, fusion and integration of the ovum and the sperm cell resulting from the formation of the human nucleus or fertilization thereof\". It provides that the rights accorded to human persons shall be recognized in the unborn from the moment of the formation of the nucleus or fertilization.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL, POLITICAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING 'CLANDESTINE LABORATORY' AND PENALIZING THE OWNERSHIP, ESTABLISHMENT, MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION THEREOF, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9165, THE 'COMPREHENSIVE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 2002', AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill clarifies that a \"clandestine laboratory\" refers to any facility used for the illegal manufacture of any dangerous drug situated not only on land or real property but also those in a boat, ship, airplane, van or on any location possible. It imposes the death penalty on the person who owns, establishes, maintains and operates a clandestine laboratory.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-09-01

It seeks to bring the crime of terrorism within the coverage of the Anti-Wire Tapping Law and the Anti-Money Laundering Law.
